name: Kousaka Masanobu
source:
[url=/c44434]Takeda Shingen's[/url] trusted retainer.
The most intellectual of the Takeda clan's militant retainers.
He's popular with women but he personally has no interest and is always running away from them.
He really adores Shingen.
